description: List drafts not sent yet, newest first, without their bodies. A draft whose email is scheduled is listed until it goes, with scheduledAt set, and cancel_send stops it. Filter by thread, or to the open drafts whose writer asked a person to look.

cursor.description: Where the last page stopped: the nextCursor of the answer before. Use it with the same filters it came with. Left out, the list starts at the beginning.

limit.description: How many to return in one page, 1 to 200. Left out, the server picks.

review.description: true: only the drafts whose writer asked a person to look.

threadId.description: Only the drafts that answer a message in this thread.

name: list_drafts
title: List drafts
